categories.main_business_segments: Sempra operates through four main reportable segments: (1) SDG&E (San Diego Gas & Electric Company), a regulated electric and gas utility in Southern California; (2) SoCalGas (Southern California Gas Company), the largest natural gas distribution utility in the U.S.; (3) Sempra Texas Utilities, which includes equity interests in Oncor and Sharyland Utilities, regulated electric transmission and distribution utilities in Texas; and (4) Sempra Infrastructure, which develops, builds, operates, and invests in energy infrastructure, including LNG, pipelines, and renewables, primarily in the U.S. and Mexico.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Sempra's core technologies and methods include large-scale electric and gas transmission and distribution networks, natural gas storage and transportation, LNG liquefaction and regasification, renewable energy generation (wind and solar), and advanced grid modernization. The company utilizes both owned and contracted generation assets, long-term infrastructure investments, and employs advanced safety, reliability, and environmental management systems across its operations.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include residential, commercial, industrial, and wholesale utility customers in California and Texas, as well as major industrial, utility, and governmental entities in Mexico and globally through LNG exports. SDG&E and SoCalGas serve millions of end-users in Southern California, Oncor serves nearly 3.9 million delivery points in Texas, and Sempra Infrastructure serves energy companies, utilities, and industrial customers in North America and international LNG markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: Sempra's operations are concentrated in Southern California (SDG&E and SoCalGas), Texas (Oncor and Sharyland Utilities), and Mexico (through Sempra Infrastructure). The company also has significant LNG export and infrastructure assets in Louisiana and Texas, and serves global LNG markets, with additional renewable and pipeline assets in Mexico.
categories.supply_chain_position: Sempra operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the energy supply chain. It owns and operates transmission and distribution infrastructure for electricity and natural gas, provides storage and regasification, and delivers energy to end-users. Through Sempra Infrastructure, it is also involved in LNG liquefaction (midstream/export) and renewable power generation (downstream).
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Sempra's strategic focus is on being North America’s premier energy infrastructure company, emphasizing investments in transmission, distribution, and clean energy infrastructure. Key R&D and innovation themes include grid modernization, renewable integration, energy storage, LNG and net-zero solutions, carbon capture and sequestration, and supporting the energy transition to lower-carbon sources. The company is also advancing digitalization, safety, and reliability initiatives.
categories.revenue_model: Sempra generates revenue primarily through regulated utility rates for electricity and natural gas delivery, cost-of-service recovery, and long-term contracts for infrastructure services. Additional revenue streams include LNG liquefaction and export tolling, renewable power purchase agreements, storage and transportation fees, and asset optimization activities. Most utility revenues are regulated and based on approved rates and capital investments.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Sempra’s main competitors include other large regulated utilities (e.g., Southern California Edison, Pacific Gas & Electric, CenterPoint Energy), independent power producers, and global LNG and pipeline operators. In Mexico and global LNG, it competes with state-owned and private energy companies. Sempra is positioned as a leading North American energy infrastructure company with strong regulated utility franchises and a growing international LNG and renewables platform.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the year ended December 31, 2022, Sempra reported total revenues of $14.4 billion and net income attributable to common shares of $2.1 billion. The company has a large asset base ($78.6 billion in total assets) and continues to invest heavily in capital projects, with $5.7 billion in capital expenditures and investments in 2022. Sempra has demonstrated steady growth in its regulated utility businesses and is expanding its infrastructure and LNG export operations.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Sempra emphasizes safe, reliable, and increasingly clean energy delivery, underpinned by stable, regulated cash flows and a strong commitment to infrastructure investment. Its unique value proposition includes a diversified portfolio of regulated utilities and infrastructure assets, leadership in the North American LNG export market, and a strategic focus on enabling the energy transition through grid modernization, renewables, and net-zero solutions. The company differentiates itself through operational excellence, regulatory expertise, and a track record of innovation and sustainability.
